payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how RNNs with arbitrary precision are proven to be as powerful as pushdown automata (PDAs).

claims.text: RNNs with one hidden layer and ReLU activation are at least as computationally powerful as pushdown automata when allowing arbitrary precision.
GRUs with infinite precision and nonlinear output activation functions are also at least as computationally powerful as pushdown automata.
The construction of RNNs shows that simple RNNs with arbitrary precision are proven to be at least as powerful as PDAs.
